claims.claim_text: Planet completed seven strategic acquisitions (BlackBridge 2015, Terra Bella 2017, Boundless Spatial 2019, VanderSat 2021, Salo Sciences 2023, Sinergise 2023, Bedrock 2025). The Bedrock acquisition was a $6.0M asset deal for multi-modal geospatial AI tech, closed Nov 14, 2025.
claims.subject: Planet Labs PBC
claims.object_value: 7 acquisitions over 10 years culminating in Bedrock AI tuck-in
claims.source_quote: We have made strategic acquisitions, including the acquisition of the BlackBridge group of companies in September 2015, the Terra Bella business from Google in April 2017, Boundless Spatial in March 2019, VanderSat in December 2021, Salo Sciences in January 2023, Sinergise in August 2023, and Bedrock in November 2025.
